caption: The drawing depicts a single metal candle holder with a wide, shallow dish base and a central cylindrical shaft for holding a candle. The candle holder also features a circular handle attached to one side of the base, allowing it to be easily carried. The cylindrical shaft has a small horizontal lever protruding from it, likely for adjusting the position or height of the candle. The illustration is rendered in shades of grey and black, suggesting it is a pencil or charcoal drawing, and is set on an off-white or light beige background. The composition is simple, with the candle holder centered and occupying most of the space within a thinly outlined rectangular border. The artist's name, "H. Bader," is signed in the lower left corner.
title: Candlestick
